title: Fluency: the price before the change

families.skill: find the price before a discount
families.prompt: A {item} costs £{sale:dp2} after {p}% off. What was its price before the discount?

wrong.line: You added {p}% of the sale price. The {p}% was taken from the higher price before the sale.
You divided by ${p/100}$. After {p}% off, {left}% is left, so divide by ${m}$.

solution: After {p}% off, {left}% is left, so the sale price is ${m}$ times the old price.
Undo it by dividing: ${sale:dp2} \div {m} = {orig:dp2}$, so the price was £{orig:dp2}.

families.skill: find the price before a rise
families.prompt: After a {p}% rise, a share is at £{after:dp2}. What was its price before the rise?

wrong.line: You took {p}% off the new price. The {p}% was of the lower price before the rise.
You divided by ${p/100}$, the rise alone. Divide by the whole multiplier, ${m}$.

solution: A {p}% rise multiplied the old price by ${m}$.
Undo it by dividing: ${after:dp2} \div {m} = {orig:dp2}$, so the price was £{orig:dp2}.

families.skill: find the VAT inside a price
families.prompt: A {item} costs £{gross:dp2} including VAT at 20%. How much of that is VAT?

wrong.line: You took 20% of the price with VAT. The 20% is of the price before VAT.
That is the price before VAT. The question asks for the VAT itself.

solution: VAT multiplies the price before tax by $1.2$, so that price is ${gross:dp2} \div 1.2 = {net:dp2}$.
